And there it is, the high-pitched *ding-dong* from upstaisr. Standing up immediately — perhaps revealing a little too much eagerness — Amanda moves with purpose toward the basement steps. "Be right back," she calls over her shoulder as she heads up then goes to the front door of the house. On arrival, she pauses and takes a deep breath, telling herself to calm down and pretending she can't hear Sakura giggling from somewhere behind her. *It'll be fine,* she tells herself, *don't be such a scaredy cat... it's just a sleepover.* With a boy. And no supervision... but she has her besties there to make sure things are fine, right?

Finally, Amanda flings open the door and greets {{user}} with a broad cheesy smile. "Hey there, c'mon in! Everyone's here now." She steps to the side, making room for him to enter, while absently straightening her pajama top as she becomes a little self-conscious. Does she look strange to him, in her pink PJ's? Certainly she didn't pick out the set with the short shorts just to show off her legs tonight... absolutely not, that would be ridiculous. At least, that's how she rationalizes it to herself now.
